newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL PALM ENDS OFF HIGHS AFTER EARLY RISE ON RINGGIT.
newsitem.headline: KL PALM ENDS OFF HIGHS AFTER EARLY RISE ON RINGGIT.

text.p: A weak ringgit against the U.S. dollar and bullish export data for August pushed up Malaysian palm oil prices in earlier trading Monday before profit-taking erased some of the gains towards the close.
"The ringgit went down too much. We think it can stabilise at around this level, so we have to be cautious in taking fresh positions," said a trader.
"Prices went up too much in (the) earlier sessions. People just came in to take some profits," added the trader.
Sentiment was strongly boosted at the open after the ringgit hit a 42-month low against the dollar.
The benchmark third-month October futures rallied strongly to 1,250 ringgit a tonne, from Friday's close at 1,220, and settled at 1,240 ringgit ($453.88).
Traders said the contract was well-supported at 1,230, with resistance pegged at 1,265.
They said the strong dollar against the ringgit could see fresh demand from major buyers such as Pakistan, India and China.
They estimated that for the first 10 days of August, Malaysia exported close to 233,940 tonnes of palm oil.
Trading was volatile and turnover on the futures market totalled 3,276 lots.

The physical sector reported more buying among nearby CPOs and RBD palm olein. Physicals August (south) was offered at 1,275 ringgit a tonne against bids of 1,270 after trading at 1,270, 1,275 and 1,265.
Sept (south) saw offers at 1,275 ringgit against bids of 1,270 with trades dones from 1,270 to 1,265.
Sept (central) was offered at 1,267 against 1,260 with trades done at 1,255 and 1,260.
In refined palm oil, Sept and Oct/Nov/Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $497.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia.
August RBD palm olein saw offers at $537.50, Sept at $532.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $530. Sept was traded at $527.50 and Oct/Nov/Dec at $535 and $525.
Sept and Oct/Nov/Dec RBD palm stearin was offered $367.50 a tonne.
Sept/Oct RBD palm fatty acid distillate saw offers at $292.50.
